title: Imperative 7: "Careful!" Warnings (не + Perfective)
description: Не + perfective is the warning form: не забудь, не упади, не опоздай, не разбей. It warns against one accidental, unwanted result. The general prohibition не + imperfective is the opposite, and today's drills make you tell them apart.
descriptionRussian: Не + СВ — это форма предупреждения: не забудь, не упади, не опоздай, не разбей. Она предупреждает об одном случайном, нежелательном результате. Общий запрет не + НСВ — это противоположный случай.
intro: Lesson 6 said prohibitions take the imperfective, and here is the exception that shows the shape of the rule. Switch to the perfective and 'do not' stops being a rule and becomes a warning: not 'never drop things' but 'careful, do not drop that'. The verbs that turn up here are all accident verbs. Forgetting, falling, breaking, being late.
rules: Не + perfective is the warning form: it cautions against one accidental, unwanted result. Examples: не забудь, не упади, не опоздай, не разбей.
Use не + perfective when the speaker is worried about a single specific moment, often after a cue like Осторожно! or Смотри! (Careful! / Watch out!).
"Accident" verbs naturally take the perfective warning: забыть, упасть, опоздать, разбить, потерять, простудиться.
The opposite "don't" is the general prohibition не + imperfective (a standing rule, like не забывай друзей). If the meaning is "this once, careful," choose the perfective instead.
examples: Не забудь ключи! (Don't forget the keys!) Не + СВ забудь; warning about one accidental result.
Осторожно, не упади на лестнице! (Careful, don't fall on the stairs!) Не + СВ упади; one risky moment.
Не опоздай на поезд! (Don't be late for the train!) Не + СВ опоздай; one specific deadline.
Смотри, не разбей чашку! (Watch out, don't break the cup!) Не + СВ разбей; one fragile object.
Не потеряй билет! (Don't lose the ticket!) Не + СВ потеряй; one item, one accident to avoid.
Не забывай старых друзей! (Don't forget your old friends.) Не + НСВ забывай; this is the standing-rule "don't," not a one-time warning.

items.promptEnglish: Don't forget the keys! (careful, just this once)
items.hint: Забыть is an accident verb, and this is a one-time warning. Which aspect?
items.explanation: A one-time warning about an accidental result takes не + perfective: не забудь. Не забывай (imperfective) would mean 'don't be the kind of person who forgets things,' a standing rule rather than this single moment.

items.promptEnglish: Careful, don't fall on the stairs!
items.hint: Осторожно (careful) frames one risky moment. Which aspect for a warning?
items.explanation: Осторожно signals a one-time warning, so use не + perfective: не упади. Не падай (imperfective) would mean 'don't fall as a habit,' which is grammatical but odd for one descent.

items.promptEnglish: Don't be late for the train!
items.hint: One specific train, one deadline. Which aspect for the warning?
items.explanation: A warning about one specific deadline takes не + perfective: не опоздай. Не опаздывай (imperfective) would mean 'don't be chronically late,' a broader habit-prohibition.

items.promptEnglish: Watch out, don't break the cup!
items.hint: Смотри (watch out) plus one fragile cup. Which aspect?
items.explanation: Смотри frames a one-time warning, so use не + perfective: не разбей. Не разбивай (imperfective) would mean 'don't go around breaking things,' a habit.

items.promptEnglish: Don't lose the ticket, we need it!
items.hint: One ticket, one accident to avoid. Which aspect for the warning?
items.explanation: A warning about losing one specific item takes не + perfective: не потеряй. Не теряй (imperfective) would mean 'don't keep losing things,' a habit.

items.promptEnglish: It's cold outside. Don't catch a cold!
items.hint: Простудиться (catch a cold) is an accident verb, and this warns about one occasion.
items.explanation: A warning about one occasion takes не + perfective: не простудись. Не простужайся (imperfective) would mean 'don't keep catching colds,' a habit.

blanks: Перед выходом скажи: не _____ паспорт! (Before leaving, say: don't forget the passport!)
Лёд на дороге. Осторожно, не _____! (There's ice on the road. Careful, don't fall!)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Both are one-time warnings about an accidental result, so both take не + perfective: не забудь, не упади. The imperfective не забывай / не падай would express a standing rule ('don't keep forgetting / falling'), not the single risky moment described here.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Careful, don't break the vase! (one fragile moment)
minimalPairs.explanation: Осторожно frames a one-time warning about an accidental result, so use не + perfective разбей. Не разбивай (imperfective) would mean 'don't go around breaking vases,' a habit-prohibition that does not fit this single fragile moment.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Don't forget your old friends. (as a rule, ever)
minimalPairs.explanation: Here the meaning is a standing rule ('never forget them'), which is the general prohibition не + imperfective забывай. Не забудь (perfective) would be a one-time warning about forgetting one specific thing right now, which does not fit 'old friends' as a lasting value.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The train is soon. Don't be late! (one specific train)
minimalPairs.explanation: A warning about one specific train takes не + perfective опоздай. Не опаздывай (imperfective) would mean 'don't be chronically late,' a broader habit-prohibition that the single-event cue does not call for.

errorCorrection.sentence: Смотри, не роняй чашку, она стеклянная!
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Watch out, don't drop the cup - it's glass!
errorCorrection.explanation: Смотри (watch out) frames a one-time warning about an accidental result, which takes не + perfective: не урони. The imperfective не роняй is a habit-prohibition ('don't keep dropping things'), which misses the single risky moment.

errorCorrection.sentence: Осторожно, не ломай ключ в замке!
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Careful, don't break the key in the lock!
errorCorrection.explanation: Осторожно frames a one-time warning about an accidental result, which takes не + perfective: не сломай. The imperfective не ломай would mean 'don't make a habit of breaking things'.

errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Watch out, don't miss our stop!
errorCorrection.explanation: A warning tied to one specific occasion (this stop, right now) takes не + perfective: не пропусти. The imperfective не пропускай is a habit-prohibition ('don't keep missing stops'), a broader claim than this moment needs.

errorCorrection.sentence: Неси суп осторожно и не проливай его!
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Carry the soup carefully and don't spill it!
errorCorrection.explanation: A warning about spilling this one bowl on this one trip takes не + perfective: не пролей. The imperfective не проливай would mean 'don't keep spilling things', a habit.

categorySorting.instruction: Sort each "don't" into a one-time warning (не + perfective) or a standing rule (не + imperfective).

sentenceBuilding.hint: Warning about one accidental result: не + perfective забудь.

sentenceBuilding.translation: Careful, don't break the vase! (one-time warning)
sentenceBuilding.hint: Осторожно plus a fragile object: не + perfective разбей.

sentenceBuilding.translation: Don't be late for the train! (one-time warning)
sentenceBuilding.hint: One specific deadline: не + perfective опоздай.

reviewVocab.definition: don't forget! (a one-time warning, не + perfective, about forgetting one specific thing)
don't fall! / careful, you might fall (a warning, не + perfective, about one risky moment)
don't be late! (a warning, не + perfective, about one specific deadline)
don't break it! (a warning, не + perfective, about breaking one fragile object)
